title: Staff Recruitment manage IA
summary: Staff Recruitment manage gets an independent Recruit manage primary with a Roles / Applications page submenu, so roles CRUD and applications review are reachable outside the APES CIC hub alone while staying separate from public Recruitment.
changes: Add a permission-gated Recruit manage primary for staff with any apes-cic.recruitment view-all, create, update, delete, or review-applications ability.
Add a Roles | Applications page submenu on staff /apes-cic/recruitment* pages (URLs unchanged).
Keep APES CIC hub Recruitment links working; do not bury manage only inside the hub.
Document and cover the HR review-applications-only path: Applications submenu visible, roles CRUD fail-closed.
Add PHPUnit RecruitmentDualFrontendIaMatrixTest for guest, public, HR, staff, admin, and superadmin chrome and fail-closed manage URLs.
Extend AGENTS.md staff manage shell notes for the dual-frontend IA.
version_rationale: Patch on the v0.36.x line: staff manage information architecture and dual-frontend test matrix without changing public URLs, staff URL baselines, or permission definitions.
validation: PHPUnit RecruitmentDualFrontendIaMatrixTest passes (guest / public / HR / staff / admin / superadmin).
Related PublicRecruitmentBoardTest, RecruitmentRoleWorkflowTest, RecruitmentApplicationManageTest, and AdminShellNavigationTest pass.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Staff manage still ships only on the APES CIC sub-core.
Public applicants with view-own may still open the staff roles list URL without the Recruit manage primary; create/edit and applications review remain fail-closed.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to remove the Recruit manage primary and Roles / Applications staff page submenu.
provenance: Implements issues #258, #259, and #261 via pull request #296; closes epic #249.
